Contract ProcessSaleService::endSale(): Real {
	definition:
		saleLines: Set(SalesLineItem) = SalesLineItem.allInstances()->select(line: SalesLineItem|line.BelongedSale = self.CurrentSale),
		resultingAmount: Real = if saleLines->isEmpty() 
		then 0.0 
		else saleLines->sumBy(line: SalesLineItem|line.Subamount) 
		endif 
	precondition:
		self.CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and
		self.CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = false
	postcondition:
		self.CurrentSale.Amount = resultingAmount and
		self.CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = true and
		self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = true and
		result = resultingAmount
}
